title: a seal's closure owner filter walks the component tree once
intention: _owned_by_the_proofs_component looks every closure path's owner up with one address.components_of call, so filtering a closure walks the component tree once.
why: Measured 2026-11-12: the home bus wedged at 100% of one core in this function, one component_of (~8.5 ms) per closure file, under codemother's shim lock; 2.66 s over 300 files.
traces_to: Law 1 (the settled component set re-derived per file is a defect) and the bus intention (a wake never takes more than 60 s).
how: Call components_of once over the proof plus the other rels and read each owner from the dict. Red-first proof counts component_dirs calls and checks the answer against a per-path filter.

clauses.claim: _owned_by_the_proofs_component over 40 closure paths calls address.component_dirs exactly once
its answer equals the per-path filter: the proof's own file, and each other rel whose component_of is the proof's owner

decisions.text: D1: _owned_by_the_proofs_component calls components_of once over the proof and the other rels.
D2: the red-first proof, one tooth per clause.

measured.saw: home bus pid 1881010 at 100% of one core in validation_store._owned_by_the_proofs_component -> address.component_of -> component_dirs under codemother's queueme; reach timed out at 120 s
measured.how: py-spy dump on akiendelllinux, relayed by the orchestrator

measured.saw: _owned_by_the_proofs_component over 300 repo files: 2.66 s; address.components_of over 300 paths: 0.03 s
measured.how: python3 timing on akienasus, after 82d203c11015 was built (commit daf9c392a)

orient.request: 9f4442c932da: a seal's closure owner filter walks the component tree once (cairn/tools/validation_store/validation_store.py)

Law 8: a tooth counts the component_dirs walks, so a hollow build that walks per path reds

whether the answer is unchanged by one walk
